risk: Orphaned BPMN activities (CallActivity_86 Content Modifier and CallActivity_77 Groovy Script)
consequence: The validation script 'GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy' and XPath extraction of OrganizationId are disconnected from the execution path. Invalid order codes will not be flagged, resulting in bad data reaching downstream receivers.
mitigation: Unit tests assert order code validation outcomes; integration suite flags orphaned nodes as quality defects before deployment.

risk: Unmatched routing default condition escalates via Escalation End (EndEvent_11)
consequence: Because the SOAP inbound adapter is configured as OneWay with 'returnExceptionToSender=false', messages with unrecognized order types terminate abruptly without informing the sender system, causing silent order loss.
mitigation: Automated scenario TC_GLOVIA_ESC_03 monitors escalation event trigger and requires alert logging or DLQ persistence.

risk: Property 'InputPayload' stores complete message body (${in.body}) in memory
consequence: High-volume or large attachment payloads stored in exchange properties lead to Java Virtual Machine (JVM) heap memory pressure and potential OutOfMemoryError in worker nodes.
mitigation: Impose body size constraint (enforced at 40MB by SOAP adapter settings) and mock large-message threshold tests.

risk: Runtime failure of externalized routing parameters ({{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}} and {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}})
consequence: Misconfigured or missing tenant parameters will result in XML condition evaluation syntax errors, dropping all messages into the escalation subprocess.
mitigation: Suite validates parameter injection into gateway conditions across deployment configuration profiles.
